fingerprintPattern: data.{0,40}(argument|must be of type).{0,80}Received undefined
description: skeleton.split truthy 判断导致 fs.writeFileSync 写 undefined

fingerprintPattern: Build failed.*ECONNRESET
description: 编译服务器连接被 reset,通常是 LINUX_BUILD_URL 指向僵尸远端而非 127.0.0.1

fingerprintPattern: entity "[a-z][A-Za-z]+" not found in
description: LLM spec extractor emits camelCase entity names; strict case-sensitive Set lookup in spec-validate blocks the pipeline with no retry path

fingerprintPattern: CUA total time limit exceeded \(\d+min > \d+min\)
description: CUA fix loop overshoots the 45-min wall-clock budget because the time guard only fires at round start, not before the expensive recode step

fingerprintPattern: aborted: same CODE error repeated (N|\d+) rounds, fix-loop not converging
description: CC CLI exit-1 error message drops stdout content, producing a constant 'Exit code 1' string that trips the fix-loop circuit breaker after exactly 3 identical rounds

fingerprintPattern: Visual freeze FATAL: \d+ consecutive rounds.*Stuck at phase \(none complet
description: noPhasesCompleted cases are mis-classified as visual_freeze, delivering wrong codegen advice on round 1 and guaranteeing FATAL on round 2 — repeated 5× by task-level retries

fingerprintPattern: Visual freeze FATAL: \d+ consecutive rounds — not fixable via claude-fix
description: visual_freeze short-circuit fires too late (≥3 rounds) because isProgressing discards 0→1 phase progress and the diagnosis keyword list was too narrow to catch VLM synonym phrasing

fingerprintPattern: Visual freeze FATAL: \d+ consecutive rounds.*Stuck at phase \(none completed\).*root cause: visual_freeze
description: noPhasesCompleted AND-condition lets visual_freeze win over codegen_init_failure when VLM issue text contains a phase-coverage count, routing zero-progress tasks to a non-retryable FATAL instead of the retryable CODE/full-regen path.

fingerprintPattern: Spec validation failed: \d+ error\(s\):.*entity "[^"]+" not found in blueprint\.entities
description: LLM spec extractor writes abbreviated entity names (e.g. 'drill' vs 'BasicDrill'); two-tier exact/case-insensitive guard misses them, burning 6 full-pipeline retries per task.

fingerprintPattern: CUA total time limit exceeded \(\d+min > 45min\)
description: Ambient system env var CUA_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS=2700000 (45 min) overrides the code's updated 75-min default, causing legitimate 47-min CUA runs to be killed prematurely.

fingerprintPattern: Schema generation failed: Exit code 14[23]
description: Schema generation times out (SIGTERM → exit 143) because the 2-minute hardcoded timeout in codegen-schema.cjs is too short for the CLI text runner when tool-call overhead adds an extra API round-trip

fingerprintPattern: Unexpected token ['"`]?`['"`]?,?\s*"```json.*is not valid JSON
description: parseSimplifyResponse passes raw ```json-fenced text to JSON.parse when LLM omits closing code fence (truncated response)

fingerprintPattern: Spec validation failed: \d+ error\(s\):.*entity "[a-z][a-zA-Z]+" not found in blueprint\.entities
description: LLM camelCases entity names in specs; entityLowerToCanonical canonical values are stored un-trimmed, allowing whitespace-polluted names to escape the auto-fix and reach codegen

fingerprintPattern: Schema validation failed:.*undefined should (NOT have additional properties|have required)
description: Ajv v6 error objects expose `dataPath`, not `instancePath`; validate-schema.cjs uses the v8 property, producing `undefined` in every validation error message

fingerprintPattern: Phase coverage too low: \d+\/\d+ \(\d+%\)\. Missing: [a-zA-Z]
description: Post-loop phase coverage gate fires with no retries because LLM reviewer silently passed code using wrong/generic phaseId names

fingerprintPattern: Cannot read properties of undefined \(reading 'length'\)
description: resolveEntities() crashes on undefined specs in schema codegen — missing null guard at entry

fingerprintPattern: Spec validation failed: \d+ error\(s\):[\s\S]*entity "[^"]+" not found in blueprint\.entities
description: spec-validate throws a permanent dead-end error because it never invalidates the spec-extract checkpoint, so every worker retry skips spec-extract and re-validates the same hallucinated entity names

fingerprintPattern: Schema validation failed:.*\.entities\[\d+\] should have required property 'chineseName'
description: _repairSchema strips chineseName/showLabel from entities before schema validation because ALLOWED_ENTITY_KEYS is missing those keys

fingerprintPattern: Spec fingerprint drift \(fatal\).*fresh-extract produced phaseId set with only \d+/\d+ overlap
description: commitSpecs() mutates ctx.blueprint.specs before the drift-fatal throw, causing the canRetry second attempt to build a non-null beforeFp from entity-valid attempt-1 output and then false-fatal against a legitimate second extraction

fingerprintPattern: CUA total time limit exceeded \(\d+min > 60min pre-recode guard\)
description: RECODE_BUFFER_MS env var (15 min / 900,000 ms) set the pre-recode guard threshold at 60 min, causing legitimate 63–64 min CUA runs to be killed prematurely before recode had a chance to run.

fingerprintPattern: \[spec-phase-skipped\].*Phases not complete
description: CUA [spec-phase-skipped] token had no rootCause branch → resolved to 'unknown', bypassing fast-escalation guard and burning up to 7 recode rounds before FATAL

fingerprintPattern: Spec fingerprint drift \(fatal\):.*fresh-extract.*phaseId set with only \d+/\d+ overlap \(\d+%\)
description: drift-fatal fires on spec-extract retry because spec-validate mutates entity names in-place on ctx.blueprint.specs, making specsAreReusable() return true so beforeFp is preserved, but the on-disk cache (pre-mutation names) is deemed stale and discarded — forcing a fresh LLM extraction whose non-deterministic phaseIds diverge from the now-entity-corrected baseline

fingerprintPattern: \[(?:visual-quality|screenshot-timing)\]\s*screenshot sharing
description: Screenshot-sharing CUA failures hit FP circuit-breaker FATAL (2–3 rounds) because 'screenshot sharing' is absent from VISUAL_FREEZE_PHRASES and has no FP-breaker exemption, so full-regen is never attempted before hard abort.

fingerprintPattern: Visual freeze FATAL: \d+ consecutive rounds — surgical and full-regen both failed
description: visual_freeze FATAL fires at _noProgressRounds=2 with no full-regen attempt because cross-streak consecutiveSameIssue counter carries over from a prior phase-progress streak

fingerprintPattern: Visual freeze FATAL: \d+ consecutive rounds — surgical and full-regen both failed
description: visual_freeze FATAL fired at _noProgressRounds=3 — regenerated code got only 1 post-regen CUA pass before pipeline abort

fingerprintPattern: Visual freeze FATAL: \d+ consecutive rounds.*root cause: visual_freeze
description: visual_freeze misclassified when phases already completed — sends wrong batch-firing advice to codegen and triggers premature FATAL escalation at round 3

fingerprintPattern: Template marker coverage failed: missing skeleton markers: TODO_PHASE_\d+_INIT
description: W1b 5-partial split: TODO_PHASE_N_INIT markers live in the Flow partial but fillSkeleton is only called on the main skeleton, causing all phase-init markers to be reported missing

fingerprintPattern: Method completeness failed: missing methods: [\w, _]+
description: method-check ignores ctx.extraFiles (partial class files) when scanning for method definitions, producing false-positive 'missing method' failures for all methods generated into Systems.cs

fingerprintPattern: Schema generation failed:.*stdout:.*(?:ECONNRESET|Unable to connect to API)
description: Schema codegen fails with ECONNRESET because HTTPS_PROXY is hardcoded to 127.0.0.1:7890 (not env-configurable), not declared in .env files, and retries fire with zero delay — all 3 attempts exhaust instantly against a downed proxy.
